# pvecli backup files

Browse the files of a Proxmox Backup Server backup (read only).

```text
pvecli backup files VOLID [PATH] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VOLID` | PBS backup volume. |
| `PATH` | Path inside the backup, e.g. /root.pxar.didx/etc. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Node to go through (default: the node holding the backup). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli backup files pbs:backup/ct/200/2026-11-18T02:00:00Z
pvecli backup files pbs:backup/ct/200/2026-11-18T02:00:00Z /root.pxar.didx/etc
```
